look_here_first: Rough leaf surface plus strongly raised netlike veins beneath; unarmed woody plant.

lookalikes.differences: Compared with C. laevigata, netleaf hackberry has thicker rougher leaves and much more conspicuous reticulate venation beneath. C. lindheimeri differs by dense white tomentum on the leaf underside.
